issues.criterion: AC1 / AC7 / build-rules §6 (hero image) / design-language §1 signature move
issues.description: The hero's signature framed-photo move renders EMPTY on the flagship claret QA brand: the frame hairline and offset claret mat draw correctly, but the frame contains no photograph — only the centered muted placeholder caption. The theme default asset /themes/redgate-lodge-bespoke/hero-default.jpg does not exist in the repo (Glob and find both returned nothing), so the final background-image fallback layer 404s, and neither QA brand carries a brand.heroImage. Result: every preview without a brand-supplied hero photo shows a photo-less hero — the one visual that defines this theme never appears. AC7's grep (layer order) passes because the CODE is correct; the defect is the missing shipped asset. Same empty render confirmed at 505/768/1024 (hero-1-home-w505/w768/w1024.png) and on the teal alt brand (hero-1-alt-home-w1440.png). Fix: ship a real hero-default.jpg at public/themes/redgate-lodge-bespoke/ (and/or ensure the QA brands seed a heroImage) so the framed photo carries an actual photograph.

The empty-frame placeholder reuses the hero eyebrow text verbatim ('INDEPENDENT USED CARS'), so the identical phrase reads twice on screen — once as the eyebrow above the h1 and again centered inside the photo frame. It scans as a duplicated label rather than intentional caption. Because the default image is currently absent (see hero-1-01), this echo is visible on every render, not just a rare fallback. The empty panel otherwise reads as an intentional matted panel (mat + hairline present, no broken-image chrome), so the graceful-degradation intent is met — but the caption should be a distinct neutral line (e.g. 'Photography coming soon') rather than the eyebrow. Minor on its own; recorded as polish.

issues.criterion: AC6 (adjacency to proof-ledger) — NOT VERIFIABLE this iteration
issues.description: AC6 requires the hero bg to meet the proof-ledger's double hairline with balanced breathing room. In this component-mode iteration only the hero (plus shared header/cookie chrome) renders on '/'; the proof-ledger and all sections below are absent (blank canvas beneath the hero). This is expected for a component-by-component build and is NOT a hero defect — the hero renders cleanly and its bottom padding clamp(2.5rem,6vw,4.5rem) is coded per spec. Flagging that the handoff cannot be confirmed until the ledger ships; re-check at full-page/pre-ship. Recorded as a note, not a fault attributable to the hero.
